producer_report.summary: Root cause: criteria were written without a defined list of what the verifier can observe. The reader brief said which commands the verifier runs but not that it sees only the final candidate tree, so readers wrote criteria that needed base-commit runs, before/after comparisons or the producer's transcript. Fix, information first: `verifier_can_run_section` now says the verifier sees only the final tree, cannot run anything on the base commit, and that before/after and 'fails without the fix' criteria are met only by the diff or a recorded Athena revert-run check. It also lists transcript and log among the producer accounts the verifier never sees. `REPORT_NOUNS` in surveys.rs gains 'transcript' and 'log', and the doc comment on `producer_evidence_phrase` names the root cause. The refusal message lists the new nouns. Two new tests and a CHANGELOG entry (expected 1% of newly refused readings) are added.

open_issues: The 1% share of newly refused readings is an estimate. I did not measure it; Athena's replay will.
I did not run the whole `cargo test --locked` once; that is left to Athena's checks.
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG edit was ambiguous because '### Changed' appears many times; I retried with the '## [Unreleased]' heading as context.
learnings: The producer shell hook rejects tail, grep and echo; only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm run, so test output cannot be piped.
REPORT_NOUNS drives all six producer-account phrase shapes, so one array edit covers every new noun.
desires: A way to run the replay of accepted readings myself, to measure the real share of newly refused readings instead of estimating 1%.
